payload.friendly_name: Lane worktrees run and verify lane code
payload.purpose_context: Tests and CLI calls inside a lane worktree import the repository root checkout's src through the editable install, so review evidence can pass against unfixed code (#7547, #7554). This mission gives each lane a verified test invocation at implement time, carries it into the work package prompts, and makes the pre-review gate record and check which tree its evidence came from.
payload.purpose_tldr: A lane's test command provably imports the lane's own code, and the pre-review gate refuses evidence from another tree.
